title: Polynomial-Time Computability of an Acceptance Bit
statement: For every nondeterministic finite Turing machine $N$ and natural numbers $d,c,A,a$, the function sending a Boolean word $y$ to the one-bit word whose bit is true exactly when the encoded input and configuration data extracted from $y$ form an accepting configuration in the language recognized by $N$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic finite Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
